item.description: - On first launch, PingWatch now finds your router from your Mac's network instead of assuming 10.0.0.1. - Scheduled speed tests are off for new installs (each test uses about 125 MB). Turn them on in Settings > Speed Test. Existing installs keep their schedule.

First public release.
- Pings your router, 1.1.1.1 and 8.8.8.8 (or any hosts you add) every second over ICMP and keeps every result. - The menu bar shows a health dot and the first host's latency; the menu shows latency, jitter and loss per host. - History window with charts and statistics from the last hour to a year, for one host or all of them. - Speed tests against Cloudflare, with the data each test uses. - Updates itself: PingWatch checks once a day and shows "Update available" in its menu.
